ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
title: Smt. Annpurna Devi extends greetings on World Environment Day
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Smt. Annpurna Devi extends greetings on World Environment Day

Protecting the environment is safeguarding humanity: Smt. Annpurna Devi

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
05 JUN 2026 3:15PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister for Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi, extended her heartfelt greetings on the occasion of
World Environment Day
.

In a post on X:
https://x.com/Annapurna4BJP/status/2062728690363252842?s=20
 the Minister remarked that protecting the environment is safeguarding humanity. She urged all to make the day meaningful by planting trees under the
Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam
 campaign and also to resolve to be committed to maintain the greenery of our earth.

"पर्यावरण की रक्षा, मानवता की सुरक्षा"
आप सभी को "विश्व पर्यावरण दिवस" की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं।
आइए, आज के दिवस को सार्थक करते हुए हम
#एक_पेड़_मां_के_नाम
 अभियान के अंतर्गत वृक्षारोपण कर, अपनी धरा की हरियाली बनाए रखने हेतु कृत संकल्पित बनें।
#WorldEnvironmentDay

pic.twitter.com/ExpCfvidW9
— Annpurna Devi (@Annapurna4BJP)
June 5, 2026
